title: Diff-scoped review of the Story 1.5 lane B fix cycle (redaction blocker and eight residual remedies)
summary: Fresh-session diff-scoped verification of one fix commit in the kit's dispatch adapter: prove no worker free text reaches any artifact after the redaction change (with mutation against the previous commit), walk the finished-run precedence matrix live from the fixed source, and verify checkpoint freshness, adapter honesty, prompt-paragraph and signal remedies, contract hygiene, frozen launch-text byte identity and surface. Report-only, no code changes. A wrong review here would let a redaction-class defect ship.
